body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-16, my own miss on the w-78d4 RED candidate 0bfd2274, which DL560 C7 stopped at cargo fmt --check). When checking format without Cargo (no cargo GO on Central), run `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check <files>`: TermAl's Cargo.toml says edition = "2024", and rustfmt's default or --edition 2021 style differs (for example, it joins a long `let x =` string on one line). Checking src/tests/mod.rs this way also follows every child test module.
